description: Four detuned sine oscillators stacked into a stereo pair, each fed back through a delay that reshapes its wave

params.text: Sets the pitch of all the oscillators together, in octaves from -9 to +9 either side of C4
Sets how far the oscillators are detuned from each other, reaching a tenth of an octave at full
Spreads the oscillators across the stereo field, from all of them centred to the outer two hard left and hard right
Sets how much of each oscillator's delayed output is fed back into its own phase; a tenth of it is fed back even with the knob fully left
Attenuverts the feedback input before it is added to the feedback knob
Sets how far back in the feedback buffer each oscillator reads itself, from one sample fully left to 4096 samples fully right
Attenuverts the delay input before it is added to the delay knob
Chooses how the oscillators are wired: Simple is four feeding back into themselves, Double is eight in two detuned banks, Entangled feeds them into each other in reverse, and Echo re-reads its buffer

inputs.text: Volt-per-octave pitch, added to the PITCH knob; the number of polyphonic voices the module runs is taken from this jack
Shifts the feedback amount, 5V covering the whole of the feedback knob's travel at full attenuverter
Shifts the feedback delay, 5V covering the whole of the delay knob's travel at full attenuverter; the total is held between the two ends

outputs.text: The left half of the stereo pair, ±5V
The right half of the stereo pair, ±5V

notes: the number of polyphonic voices is taken from the V/OCT jack, and both outputs carry that many.
the feedback buffer is 4096 samples long, so the longest delay the knob can reach gets shorter as the engine sample rate rises.
menu: Detune offset — sets where in the detune pattern the oscillators start
Detune rotation speed — sets how fast the detune pattern turns through the oscillators
Detune rotation amp — sets how far through the detune pattern that rotation reaches
Reset detune phase — puts the rotating detune pattern back to its start

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic
